description: The only thing that crosses the L1→L2 boundary. L1 authenticates and admission-controls; L2 never sees a socket, a secret, or an unauthenticated byte. Decoded body size is the enforceable field; body_base64 exists because JSON cannot carry arbitrary bytes (UTF-8 decode failures are exactly the M-9 exception-path class).

auth_outcome.description: ADR-005 attach at the boundary. status=fail MUST NOT proceed to triage — the envelope is recorded for audit and the delivery is refused/failed-open per route policy, but no unauthenticated byte reaches L2 normalization.

onboarding.description: True when the delivery was accepted under onboarding fail-open. Never true in production posture.

reason_code.description: Terse ADR-005 reason code. Known values: ok | no_secret | no_secret_prod | no_signature | missing_signature | bad_signature_format | bad_timestamp | stale_timestamp | bad_mac | legacy_signature | legacy_unsigned_ts | replay_rejected (reserved for R-5 seen-signature cache). Open string — new codes are additive, never redefined (Tolerant Reader).

scheme.description: hmac-adr005: X-Sentinel-Timestamp + X-Sentinel-Signature, sha256=<hex> over '<ts>.<raw body>', |now-ts|<=300s. none: no scheme applied (pre-R-1 /v2/enqueue) — recorded honestly, never silently.

status.description: pass: HMAC verified. fail: refused (403 / fail-open forward of raw bytes, never triage). bypassed_onboarding: SENTINEL_WEBHOOK_ONBOARDING=1 accepted unsigned loudly — logged, metered, health-flagged.

body_base64.description: The raw request body, base64-encoded. Decoded size MUST equal body_size_bytes and MUST NOT exceed the route cap (512 KiB on /v2/enqueue; 8 MiB on /webhook/generic until R-2 lands).

body_size_bytes.description: Decoded body size in bytes. Bodies over the route cap never cross this boundary — L1 rejects with 413 before constructing the envelope.

headers.description: HTTP request headers as received, keys lowercased. MUST NOT contain secret material or the presented signature value (see what-never-crosses).

received_at.description: When L1 accepted the delivery (ISO-8601). Distinct from any sender-supplied timestamp.

request_id.description: The trace ID born at ingress (R-3): honored from X-Request-ID when the sender supplies one, generated otherwise. Carried through every later stage (C5).

route.description: The ingress route that accepted the delivery. Post-R-1 both routes carry the ADR-005 HMAC scheme; until then the auth_outcome records the asymmetry honestly.

title: RawInbound — the L1 INGEST → L2 NORMALIZE envelope (contract C1)
